steps: Charge approved starting material and solvent into the reactor
Reaction and work-up (per approved batch record)
Drying of the wet cake in dryer D-02
In-process check: loss on drying (LOD) of the dried intermediate

in_process.test: Loss on drying (LOD) of dried intermediate

deviation.title: Intermediate LOD above limit after drying, batch API-2026-014
deviation.description: The in-process LOD of the dried intermediate was 0.9%, above the batch record limit of not more than 0.5%.
deviation.expected: Dried intermediate meets LOD not more than 0.5% before it moves on to milling.
deviation.observed: LOD 0.9%. The dryer printout shows the cycle ended about 2 hours before the time stated in the batch record.
deviation.classification_rationale: Out-of-limit in-process result at an important step. It could affect API quality if the batch had moved on. No product has left the plant.
deviation.containment: Batch put on HOLD. Dried intermediate kept in the quarantine area and labelled. Dryer D-02 tagged 'do not use' until checked. No new batch loaded into D-02. QA informed the same day.

checklist.item: Reviewed the executed batch record for the drying step
checklist.finding: Batch record states a drying time but has no step to check the dryer setpoint. Operator signed 'dryer ready'.

checklist.item: Checked dryer D-02 logbook and cycle printout
checklist.finding: Cycle ended about 2 h early. Controller timer still held the shorter time used for the previous product.

checklist.item: Verified the LOD test itself (method, balance, analyst, sample handling)
checklist.finding: Test done correctly, balance calibration in date. Re-test of the same sample confirmed 0.9%.
Operator stopped the dryer when the controller showed 'cycle complete'. He was never told to verify the timer.

checklist.item: Checked dryer D-02 calibration and maintenance records
checklist.finding: Temperature probe calibration in date. No equipment fault found.

checklist.item: Checked starting material lot and supplier certificate (CoA)
checklist.finding: CoA and QC results normal. Another batch from the same lot dried normally, so the material is not the cause.

checklist.item: Searched for similar past deviations (trend check)
checklist.finding: One earlier event on D-02 (DEV-2025-031) was closed as 'operator error, retrained'. Same type of problem.

five_whys: The wet cake was not dried for the full time.
The dryer cycle ended about 2 hours early.
The controller timer was still set to the previous product's shorter time.
Nothing in the batch record makes the operator check or set the timer before starting. It only asks for a 'dryer ready' signature.
When the batch record was last revised the setpoint check was not included, and the earlier similar event was closed as operator error without looking at the record design.
investigation.root_cause: Batch record design gap: no documented dryer setpoint verification before starting a cycle. The earlier similar deviation was closed with retraining only, so the system cause was never fixed.

impact.product_quality: Intermediate is out of the LOD limit and may not proceed as is. Re-drying (reprocessing) is allowed only under an approved procedure with QA approval, followed by a repeat LOD and final API testing that must meet specification.
impact.other_batches: Reviewed the last 10 batches dried in D-02: cycle printouts match batch records and no other out-of-limit LOD results were found.
impact.equipment: Dryer hardware is fine. The issue is setpoint control, not an equipment fault.
impact.customer_patient: No material from this batch has been released or shipped. Final API testing is done before release, so no impact on distributed product.

correction.action: Re-dry the intermediate under the QA-approved reprocessing procedure, then repeat the LOD test.

actions.action: Add a documented dryer setpoint check, with a second-person signature, to the drying step of the batch record.
Train drying-area operators and supervisors on the revised batch record.
Review batch records for all dryers and products for a missing setpoint verification step and revise where needed.

effectiveness.plan: Review the next 5 batches dried in D-02 and the next quarterly deviation trend: no early cycle end, no out-of-limit LOD, setpoint check signed in every record.

qa.comments: Root cause is supported by evidence (dryer printout, batch record design, earlier event). CAPA targets the system cause, not only retraining. Effectiveness check scheduled.

release.comments: Batch meets specification after approved reprocessing. Deviation closed. CAPA continues to be tracked under CAPA-2026-012.
